notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Here are the improvements we've made:

[list]
[*] Fixed issues with obtaining certain achievements
[*] Now you can skip the initial dialogue
[*] Fixed bugs in level 46
[*] Fixed bugs in level 47
[*] Fixed bugs in level 52
[*] Fixed bugs in level 54
[/list]

We hope these changes enhance your gaming experience. Thank you for your support!

Thank you to nana for finding many of these bugs. Are you having trouble completing any levels? Take a look at this guide: 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2964212139
